Seafood in Danang is great but food at Sadec 6 is excellent!!’
Nov 2019 • Friends
Well, do plan a lot of time to chill, to take photos, and to enjoy food and dessert here (heart)(heart) (heart)

Well we intended to drop by to say hello to a friend only, or have a drink at most and then head to a seafood place. We however instantly fell in love with the house, its green and every little beautiful corners. We came in a group of over 10 people but in just seconds i found them all disappear...to take pictures despite being tired and thirsty walking almost 1km with luggage (my fault :)). 

As we hang out, breathing in ocean breeze we were served with drinks, and me a dessert called “beauty enhancer” (well, who could say no? I could not). It was so good that ordered a second (and well, a third later after the actual meal :)).

Then it came the main course. We made the orders coz we were afraid it might take some time. It didnt. The owners kept telling us order less (not to waste food) but we ended ordering more simply the food is so so so good. I would hv to admit it perhaps was one of best meals i have got in months. Literally all the dishes at Sadec 6 was simply excellent! Cannot wait to come back 🥰
